data.narrative:
Anthro Energy is a Series A climate and energy technology company founded by David Mackanic and Joe Papp that has raised $20M to date. The valuation landscape for this sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers across climate and energy, including notable companies such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparable data within the narrow climate and energy peer set, traditional peer-median valuation was not applicable. The analysis instead relied on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to the next funding stage. Using the $20M total raised as a valuation proxy, this method implies a post-money valuation of $40M.

The triangulated valuation range supported by this analysis is $34M to $46M, with a central estimate of $40M. The primary uncertainty stems from limited same-stage comparable transactions in this sector, which constrains the robustness of peer-based benchmarking. Investors should note that this valuation is highly sensitive to the applicability of the 2.0x stage multiplier to Anthro Energy's specific risk profile and market position relative to the broader climate and energy investment landscape.
